lines.t: Oh-oh, oh-oh…
Wake up the love inside.
I made a map of everything I feared,
Drew every border till the world disappeared.
Kept my convictions in a polished frame,
But walked past sorrow when it called my name.
I wanted peace without an open door,
Wanted forgiveness while I kept the score.
Now all the answers I rehearsed so well
Fall into silence when I face myself.
Lord, I’ve been asking You to move
While keeping everything in place.
Tonight I’m turning toward the truth—
No more looking away.
Give me a heart that’s alive,
Not just a light in the window.
Love that will step outside
Where the lonely and the lost go.
Open my hands, open my eyes,
There’s someone to love on the other side.
Give me a heart that’s alive—
Wake up the love inside.
Oh-oh, let it begin,
Out of my hands and into the wind.
Oh-oh, nothing to hide—
Wake up the love inside.
There’s an old apology beneath my tongue,
Waiting for a day that never comes.
Waiting for a day that never comes.
I called it wisdom when I walked away,
But pride was choosing every word I’d say.
YahuShua, teach my feet
The road my words already know.
Let the mercy I receive
Be the mercy that I show.
Give me a heart that’s alive,
Not just a light in the window.
Love that will step outside
Where the lonely and the lost go.
Open my hands, open my eyes,
There’s someone to love on the other side.
Give me a heart that’s alive—
Wake up the love inside.
Wake up the love inside.
Let me give without a bargain,
Let me love and let it grow.
Give me a heart that’s alive,
Not just a light in the window.
Love that will step outside
Where the lonely and the lost go.
Open my hands, open my eyes,
There’s someone to love on the other side.
Give me a heart that’s alive—
Wake up the love inside.
Wake up the love inside.
Open the door.
Let mercy reach farther.
Give me a heart that’s alive.
Nothing to prove.
Someone to love.
Lord, let it start with me.
